title: Interrogation
description: The questioning layer for one trend, written by the Interrogator: provenance checks, assumption probes and a pre-mortem, each a group of one to three questions (DM-9, 4 Oct 2026: QUESTIONS_PER_GROUP_MAX = 3, kept in step with constants.js by M1-U5). The intuition prompt is not here; it lives on the Trend because it is the only question shown before the gut reading (A-4). Assumption probes are held per trend, not per reading, so that no lens receives more questioning than another. Every question ends with a question mark: these are questions, not advice. Shipped inside the trend's reveal bundle.

provenanceChecks.description: Shown first of the three groups, by the fixed sequence of C-4; within the group, fixture order, which the Interrogator's rule keeps free of importance.

preMortem.description: A group like the others since DM-9 (previously a single question).

label.description: Written offline by the Interrogator: ai-generated (DM-2).
